en.description: Warm social engagement, reassuring safety oversight, and gentle daily support delivered right to your home.
en.cardDesc: Building positive, trusting relationships and joyful daily interactions.
en.overviewTitle: Fostering meaningful engagement and everyday well-being
en.overviewDesc: Our companion care services focus on building positive, trusting relationships while ensuring safety and comfort in familiar home surroundings. From engaging conversations to light routine assistance, we provide dependable presence and peace of mind.
en.servicesDesc: Our companion care offerings are designed to enhance daily life through friendly interaction and dependable support.

servicesList.title: Companionship
servicesList.desc: Warm, friendly conversation, shared hobbies, reading, and pleasant social interaction.

servicesList.title: Social Engagement
servicesList.desc: Encouraging participation in favorite activities, community events, and family connections.

servicesList.title: Safety Monitoring
servicesList.desc: Reassuring supervision around the house to prevent hazards and ensure immediate assistance when needed.

servicesList.title: Support with Daily Routines
servicesList.desc: Gentle reminders for daily activities, schedules, and routine lifestyle habits.

servicesList.title: Light Assistance in the Home
servicesList.desc: Help with light organizing, tidying, plant care, and maintaining a comfortable living environment.

servicesList.title: Family Caregiver Support
servicesList.desc: Providing dependable relief and regular updates so family caregivers can rest and recharge with confidence.

servicesList.title: Recreational Activities & Games
servicesList.desc: Enjoying board games, puzzles, crafts, and listening to favorite music together to keep spirits bright.

servicesList.title: Friendly Visiting & Mealtime Chats
servicesList.desc: Sharing meals and tea time together with warm conversation and attentive, caring presence.

en.ctaDesc: Talk to our team about scheduling and how we can help.

es.description: Cálida interacción social, supervisión tranquilizadora de seguridad y apoyo diario amable entregado directamente en su hogar.
es.cardDesc: Construyendo relaciones positivas y de confianza e interacciones diarias alegres.
es.overviewTitle: Fomentando el compromiso significativo y el bienestar cotidiano
es.overviewDesc: Nuestros servicios de compañía se enfocan en construir relaciones de confianza mientras garantizan la seguridad y comodidad en el entorno hogareño familiar.

servicesList.title: Monitoreo de Seguridad

servicesList.title: Apoyo con Rutinas Diarias
